title: A rich document: Format ▸ Font ▸ Baseline ▸ Superscript and Outline on a selected character save to RTF
note: TE-14: Superscript (\super1) and Outline (\outl) apply to the selected character and save as RTF; the expected file is the exact bytes rmac_editor::rich::rtf::write produces, and a document that never uses these attributes writes none of their controls (rich-text-bold-save).
